notes.title: VERSION 1.0 - The Adventure Update
notes.notes:
V1.0 CHANGELOG

Fixed damage indicators only spawning along a line instead of within an area
Fixed damage indicators not appearing on the bosses

Changed the font of the text in the game
Changed the colour of the damage indications so they do not blend in with the background
Changed some walls in some levels
Increased area from where some bosses can be activated from
Decreased the speed of Sloth's swords extending / retracting

Added invincibility frames to the player
Added Adventures - Adventures are areas you can explore after defeating the boss from those lands to be able to unlock new abilities and armour by participating in the adventure's activity
Added Adventure "Arena"
Added Adventure "Archeology"
Added Adventure "Cave Exploration"

notes.title: Version 0.2
notes.notes:
Fixed Rifle not doing damage
Fixed glitch causing some players to be unable to move

Changed colour of bosses' health bar from blue to red
Change the colours of most menus
Changed name of the executable game file
Some buttons in menus will now highlight when hovered over

Added a pause menu
Added tooltips in the loadout menu to show what items do and what their stats are

notes.title: Version 0.1
notes.notes:
Fixed issue being unable to move no first launch
Fixed oculus vr launching on game start
Fixed character continuing to move if a movement key was hold during menu open
Fixed dash ability not requiring energy to be used

Changed how the dash ability works
Minor text changes on information board

Added visual to hitscan weapons
Added social media links onto the information board
Added some voice actors to the credit list
